events.text: Siniša Mihajlović was appointed new head coach of Catania, taking over from Atzori.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 8 December 2009 , Siniša Mihajlović was appointed new head coach of Catania , taking over from Atzori .

events.text: Mihajlović signed a contract until June 2011 with the Elefanti.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He signed a contract until June 2011 with the Elefanti .

events.text: Catania appointed Marco Giampaolo as new head coach for the 2010–11 season.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Catania appointed Marco Giampaolo as new head coach for the 2010–11 season .
